work_items.name: Android on-device DSH runtime
work_items.description:
Research completed 2026-10-22. Implement an ARM64 APK-packaged PRoot runtime with pinned Ubuntu/glibc + Node 24 + DSH. DSHA reference commit edcbe634874c57c3815170bf0fb44f11ed91af46 has both bxroot and PRoot; retain PRoot as the compatibility baseline and evaluate bxroot after the same device gates. Android target API 29+ blocks execve from writable app storage, so runtime executables/loaders must live in nativeLibraryDir, not an extracted Termux script.
Implementation plan and primary sources: https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/v2/docs/ANDROID-DSH.md
Next: pin source/binary hashes and licenses; prove cold-install shell + Node + DSH + provider turn in Niobium. Then validate native modules/PTYS, delegated work, per-run loopback authentication, Keystore secrets, process-tree ownership/Stop, process death, signed upgrade preserving workspace and 16 KB page-size compatibility on real ARM64 devices.
Current Android release supports remote DSH only. Embedded stability is not yet established.

work_items.name: Accessibility, tablet layouts and performance
work_items.description:
Quality suite expanded and passed locally for the 2.0 beta: 17 iOS unit + 2 native UI tests; 16 Android tests including real OkHttp/WebSocket fixture and access provisioning; 13 Hermes watcher tests; 5 asset/provenance checks; 38 pure Swift PixelSpec assertions; Plane sync and site link checks. Android debug/release and lint, iOS standard/full builds and signed archive/export/upload passed. CI runs shared, Android and iOS suites.

Greptile reviewed PR #1. All seven concrete findings were addressed: chat selection ordering, resumed streaming, clarification cancellation, helper-detail races, preview/save separation, provisioning coverage and Plane deployment instructions. Earlier six Codex findings were resolved too.

Remaining acceptance: physical-device accessibility, VoiceOver/TalkBack, dynamic type/contrast/touch targets, reduced motion, both themes, tablet/keyboard/safe areas, large histories, battery usage and provider-backed transport recovery. Website browser visual QA remains unverified because automatic approval denied browser access. Keep this item in progress.
